description:
A single YouTube video by URL or ID: title, description, exact views, likes, duration, publish date, category, keywords and channel.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id` OR `video`.
Returns: video_id (string), link (string), title (string), description (string), duration_seconds (integer, nullable), view_count (integer, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), published_at (string, nullable), category (string, nullable), is_live (boolean), is_family_safe (boolean, nullable), playability (string, nullable), keywords (array<string>), thumbnail_url (string, nullable), channel (object).

url.description: YouTube video URL (a bare ID also works). Example: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw"

name: youtube_video
title: YouTube video
